digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and testing
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that working Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when credentials come from a Git credential helper
AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST polling should use 'git credential fill' when credentials are stored in a Git credential helper, not curl --netrc
Documented credential handling patterns must never echo or log passwords and must preserve existing git push and Gerrit gate guidance
Tests in test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert correct use of git credential fill, curl --netrc conditions, the 401 false-negative explanation, and no-password-logging requirement
